description: Catalog of intentionally broken figure mutations used to test whether the QA layer detects and reports the correct rule violations.

mutations.description: Axis and tick text is rendered below the journal's minimum final-size font requirement.
Axis labels describe a measured quantity without declaring units.
Error bars are labeled as standard deviation but computed as standard error, or vice versa.
Small-sample continuous data is summarized by mean-only bars, hiding the underlying distribution.
Paired observations are aggregated into independent group bars, destroying pair identity.
Unordered categorical operating points are connected by a continuous line.
A rainbow or jet colormap is used for a sequential quantitative encoding.
A critical categorical distinction relies solely on hue with no redundant cue.
Text or graphical objects fall below WCAG-like contrast thresholds.
Legend or annotation overlaps data marks or neighboring panels.
A label, error bar, or annotation is clipped by panel boundaries.
Related panels use inconsistent axis ranges or units.
